headline: ASX has delivered positive returns 4 out of every 5 years over 150 years, with average up-year gains of 16% and average down-year losses of 10.1%

This statistical framing underpins the case for staying invested through cycles rather than trying to time markets or chase explosive short-term gains.
quote: During this time, there have been 120 up years and 30 down years. So exactly 4 out of 5 years the market has risen, and 1 out of 5 years you are wondering why you invested in the stock market! During the 1 in 5 years when the market did drop, it fell by an average of -10.1% (dividends less capital losses). Over the same timeframe, when the market rose, it was by an average of 16.0% per annum (dividends plus capital growth). When we combine positive and negative years, we arrive at an average of 10.8% per annum.
